name: assistente-delta
description: Painel de Atendimento Web e Inteligência Artificial VEGA da Delta Plan

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
